top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete physiology-to-medicine chain: GLP-1 secretion and the incretin effect in humans (Holst), proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology (Drucker), and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov). Independent randomised trials have since established metabolic, cardiovascular and renal benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity, so the work is mature. The three-name allocation keeps the citation on the physiology and the active peptide rather than on specific drugs, and an award is clearly preferable to no award.
